''See also: [[Ruler Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A Ruler is a powerful entity characterized by the ability to utilize [[Ruler techniques]]. Unlike standard practitioners who manipulate their own [[madra]], [[Rulers]] use their [[madra]] as a catalyst to exert control over [[vital aura]]. This process requires significant concentration and time, especially when executing widespread techniques. These abilities allow a Ruler to dominate the environment, such as controlling [[Wind aura|wind aura]] or manipulating space, and can even be used to inflict intense physical agony or force others to submit to their will. Those following the [[Path of the White Fox]] can specifically direct light and [[dream aura]] to ensnare opponents in a [[Fox Dream]]. In a political context, the term also refers to sovereigns such as kings, emperors, and monarchs who lead empires or clans. Notable historical figures include King [[Daruman the First]], a wise leader who established a golden age, and the [[Silent King]], whose influence could reach across planets. Some [[Rulers]] possess [[Authority|authority]] that is both political and conceptual, sometimes leaving behind crystallized commands to allow others to borrow their power.}}
